arguments.command:
python -c "
# Current regex from semver.py
import re

current_regex = r'''^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $'''

regex = re.compile(current_regex, re.VERBOSE)

# Test cases from semver.org
test_cases = [
    '0.0.4',         # valid
    '1.2.3',         # valid  
    '10.20.30',      # valid
    '1.1.2-prerelease+meta',  # valid
    '1.1.2+meta',    # valid
    '1.1.2+meta-valid',  # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha',   # valid
    '1.0.0-beta',    # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha.beta',  # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha.beta.1',  # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha.1',     # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha0.valid',  # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha.1',     # valid
    '1.0.0-alpha-valid', # valid
    '1.0.0-0.3.7',     # valid
    '1.0.0-x.7.12.w.z',  # valid
    '1.0.0-0a',      # valid
    '1.0.0+a',       # valid
    '1.0.0+0a',      # valid
    '1.0.0+0a.1b2c', # valid
]

for tc in test_cases:
    m = regex.match(tc)
    print(f'{tc}: {\"valid\" if m else \"INVALID\"}')"
